summary: Stratus Properties Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary College Station 1892 Properties, L.L.C. entered into an Agreement of Sale and Purchase to sell the retail component of the Jones Crossing mixed-use development in College Station, Texas to Brixmor Operating Partnership LP for $46.5 million in cash. The retail component includes 154,092 square feet of retail space, pad sites, and 22 undeveloped commercial acres. At closing, the purchaser assumes ground lease obligations. Post-sale, Stratus retains the 21-acre multi-family component. Estimated pre-tax net cash proceeds are approximately $20 million after costs and loan repayment. Closing is expected in Q2/Q3 2026, subject to inspection period expiration and customary conditions. The purchaser paid $465,000 in earnest money, with an additional $465,000 due post-inspection. Watch for the inspection period ending May 29, 2026, and any termination risks.
